# openQ4 Code of Conduct

We want openQ4 to be a welcoming, productive community for everyone interested in
keeping Quake 4 playable on modern systems. This Code of Conduct applies to all
project spaces, including the issue tracker, pull requests, discussions,
Discord server, and any other channel where community members interact.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Being respectful, patient, and constructive in all interactions.
- Giving and accepting feedback gracefully.
- Focusing on what is best for players, contributors, and the long-term health
  of the project.
- Showing empathy toward others who may have different experience levels,
  backgrounds, or opinions.
- Communicating clearly and assuming good intent.
- Acknowledging the contributions of others, including upstream projects and
  reverse-engineering reference work.

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, or abusive language of any kind.
- Personal attacks, insults, or derogatory comments about individuals or groups.
- Trolling, deliberate disruption, or repeated off-topic arguments.
- Publishing private information about others without permission.
- Spamming, excessive self-promotion, or unsolicited advertising.
- Advocating for, distributing, or using leaked proprietary materials, code, or
  assets in project spaces. openQ4 does not target compatibility with leaked or
  proprietary game code, and discussion of such materials is not welcome here.
- Dismissing or demeaning contributors based on how a change was authored,
  provided the work is verified and meets project standards.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces and also applies when an
individual is representing the project in public spaces. Examples include using
an official project email address, posting via an official social media account,
or acting as an appointed representative at an online or offline event.

## Enforcement

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing this Code of Conduct.
They may take any action they consider appropriate, including but not limited to:

- Requesting that a participant change their behavior.
- Removing, editing, or rejecting comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues,
  or other contributions that violate this Code of Conduct.
- Temporarily or permanently banning a participant from project spaces for
  repeated or severe violations.

All enforcement decisions will be made with the goal of preserving a healthy,
productive community.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, or have other concerns,
please contact the maintainers through a private channel such as Discord direct
message or, where available, the contact information listed on the project
website. Reports will be handled confidentially.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is inspired by and adapted from the [Contributor Covenant,
version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Questions

If you are unsure whether something is appropriate, err on the side of respect
and ask a maintainer. We are happy to help.
